paragraphs.source_en: “Listen well: too much victory is no different from eating too much—it can only do harm. You must remember that well.” Despite saying this, Ieyasu still accepted Masazumi’s proposal. “Reward Tadatsugu.”

units.source_en: “Listen well: too much victory is no different from eating too much—it can only do harm.
units.source_zh: “你听着，胜之太过，便与多食无二，只能有害。

units.source_en: Despite saying this, Ieyasu still accepted Masazumi’s proposal. “Reward Tadatsugu.”
units.source_zh: 尽管口上这样说，家康还是同意了正纯的建议，“褒奖忠继。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你听着，胜之太过，便与多食无二，只能有害。你要好生记着。”尽管口上这样说，家康还是同意了正纯的建议，“褒奖忠继。”

paragraphs.source_en: At the time, however, Masazumi did not grasp the deeper meaning of Ieyasu’s words. It is said that he truly understood them only after Lord Ieyasu’s death, when his political enemies drove him into a remote corner of Ōshū. But that belongs to a later part of the tale.

units.source_en: At the time, however, Masazumi did not grasp the deeper meaning of Ieyasu’s words.
units.source_zh: 但此时正纯并未意识到家康话中之深意。

units.source_en: It is said that he truly understood them only after Lord Ieyasu’s death, when his political enemies drove him into a remote corner of Ōshū.
units.source_zh: 据说，直到家康公逝后，正纯被政敌驱至奥州一隅时，才真正明白此中意思。

units.source_en: But that belongs to a later part of the tale.

paragraphs.source_zh: 但此时正纯并未意识到家康话中之深意。据说，直到家康公逝后，正纯被政敌驱至奥州一隅时，才真正明白此中意思。此为后话，不言。

paragraphs.source_en: Until the eighth day of the eleventh month, when he met at Nijō Castle with the venerable Tenkai, who had hastened to the capital, Ieyasu remained utterly distraught. After meeting Tenkai, however, he recovered his vigor and once again immersed himself in affairs of state.

units.source_en: Until the eighth day of the eleventh month, when he met at Nijō Castle with the venerable Tenkai, who had hastened to the capital, Ieyasu remained utterly distraught.
units.source_zh: 冬月初八于二条城会见急急进京的天海上人之前，家康始终失魂落魄。

units.source_en: After meeting Tenkai, however, he recovered his vigor and once again immersed himself in affairs of state.
units.source_zh: 但见过天海之后，他再次恢复了活力，埋首政务。

paragraphs.source_zh: 冬月初八于二条城会见急急进京的天海上人之前，家康始终失魂落魄。但见过天海之后，他再次恢复了活力，埋首政务。

paragraphs.source_en: On the tenth day of the eleventh month, Hidetada arrived at Fushimi Castle at the head of a great army.

units.source_en: On the tenth day of the eleventh month, Hidetada arrived at Fushimi Castle at the head of a great army.
units.source_zh: 冬月初十，秀忠率大军抵达伏见城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 冬月初十，秀忠率大军抵达伏见城。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus the armies of Edo and Osaka formally took their positions against one another.

units.source_en: Thus the armies of Edo and Osaka formally took their positions against one another.
units.source_zh: 至此，江户与大坂两军正式对垒。

paragraphs.source_zh: 至此，江户与大坂两军正式对垒。
